knobs.goal: Apply one mechanical change at every site in the codebase, each in isolation, verify each result, and land the passing sites together on one branch
knobs.args: { change, scope? }: the change to make at every site, and where to look for sites

nodes.name: discover sites
nodes.logic: The sites are the work-list for the pipeline. Everything downstream depends on this list being complete, so it is not the place to save on the model. Anything left out of scope is returned, not dropped.

knobs.prompt: Find every site in `scope` that needs `change` and group them into units that can change independently; list what was left out of scope and why
knobs.output: { sites: [{ id, files[], note }], outOfScope: [{ files[], reason }] }

nodes.name: make sites disjoint
nodes.logic: If a file appears in two sites, merge those sites into one unit, so no two transforms edit the same file and the branches merge cleanly.

nodes.name: any sites?
nodes.logic: With no sites, skip straight to the report.

children.name: migrate
children.logic: Each site is transformed and checked on its own; a site that still fails after its retry drops out without stopping the rest.

children.name: transform until it passes
children.logic: A failed check sends its failures back to the transform for one more try.

knobs.stopCondition: the check passes, at most 2 rounds

children.name: transform
children.logic: Agents edit files in parallel, so each one gets its own worktree and commits to its own branch. On a retry it gets the failures of the last check and fixes them in the same worktree.

knobs.prompt: Apply `change` to this site only, commit it on the site's branch; on a retry, fix the reported failures
knobs.output: { changed: boolean, branch, worktree, files[], summary }

children.name: check
children.logic: Runs inside the worktree the transform returned, not the main checkout, so it checks the transformed code. Exact pass or fail: typecheck and the site's tests only.

knobs.prompt: In the site's worktree: run the typecheck and the tests that cover the site's files; report pass or fail with the failures

children.name: split passed and failed
children.logic: Sites whose last check passed go on to the merge, with their branches; the rest are kept, with their failures, for the report.

children.name: merge passing sites
children.logic: One agent, one after the other: merges every passing site's branch into one integration branch. A branch that conflicts is left out and reported, not forced.

knobs.prompt: Create an integration branch and merge each passing site's branch into it in turn; leave out and report any that conflict

children.name: check the whole
children.logic: Sites that pass alone can still break together: the full typecheck and the full test suite on the integration branch.

knobs.prompt: On the integration branch, run the whole typecheck and the whole test suite; report pass or fail with the failures

children.name: find leftovers
children.logic: Searches the integration branch again for sites in scope that still need the change: ones the scout missed. They go to the report; they are not migrated in this run.

knobs.prompt: On the integration branch, search `scope` for any site that still needs `change`

nodes.name: report
nodes.logic: Runs whether or not there were sites.

knobs.prompt: Report the integration branch and whether the whole check passed, then the sites migrated, failed (with failures), conflicted, left over and out of scope
knobs.output: { branch?, ok, migrated[], failed[], conflicted[], leftovers[], outOfScope[] }
